verdict: DEAD (converged, frozen-measured). Law-only kill gate passes kinematically (model-IK reach on Bench(110,360) 0.814 seed A / 0.825 seed B vs the lead's 0.742) but the twist does not survive the full model: every free CMA stream started at +10..+30 deg anterior walked the J3 twist back to -8..+2 (lead -6.8), an LHS start converged onto the lead's seats; twist held at +8 / +15 converges +2.2 / +7.4 fast worse. Best fast 16.74 (lead 15.57; 13 streams, 4869 CMA configs, gate 0.13/0.00/0.13). Frozen exact Bench(110,360) through the lead's verifier CorrModel: best 24.46 (C0: lead axis + wide dyad; score 91.10; near-touch 27.70) vs the lead 22.82; best-fast configs 25.70 / 25.85; twist +8 27.54 (reach 0.742, overhead 9/28 - the highest reach, paid in band and follow); held out (A2) 28.44 vs 26.75.
limiter: parking, not kinematics: a J3 twist moves J2's GH ray lateral/down (az2 57, el2 38) where hub 2 / link 2 lift out of band (0.68 / 0.49-0.62); keeping J2 parked makes a2 69-77 and link 2 / hub 3 ride over the deltoid (contact 0.06-0.07); the b3 tilt that keeps hub 3 low costs 7-14 knee poses. Frozen, the wide dyad recovers 10 fold poses (76 vs 86) and loses them again to skin contact (11 vs 4), knee slide (12 vs 7) and clip follow (0.955): the stretched fold wall and the skin-contact wall coincide on the overhead poses.
note: Model = the verified lead's module with a seat transform (effective J3 axis e3d/e3a + b3 tilt solved on the rest skin; J2 GH ray from a1A/a2 via circ_int). Searches on the farm: LHS 192 (best 21.77), CMA A1/A2/A3/B1/C0 (seeds A/B/lead+wide dyad), L1-L3 (LHS top), P1/P2 (J2 parked), R1 (restart), T8/T15 (twist fixed). Convergence gate (all 4869 CMA configs): gain over 2nd half 0.13, last third 0.00, top-5 spread 0.13 score points; every stream individually < 1 / < 0.5 / < 3 except B1 (still walking the twist back: 6.11 / 4.52 / 0.56). Frozen exact (corr metal): C0 24.46, A2 25.52, R1 25.70, L2 25.85, A1 26.16, T8 27.54, LHS 28.55, A3@+8.5 31.01. Red team: min metal 0.03 mm (C0, overhead plane 60 elev 150 axial -105), near-touch 1 mm 27.70 / 2 mm 37.84 (lead 44.08), rod post 20.5 mm (rocker 0.77 in band), law ends at lift-off (m3e 0). 3 active (K slaved, never read), 0 passive translations, complexity 49 (as the lead).
